note.question: What determines the staffing problem for the batch arrival queue?
note.overview: In many different settings, requests for service can arrive in near or true simultaneity with one another. This creates batches of arrivals to the underlying queueing system. In this paper, we study the staffing problem for the batch arrival queue.
